(async()=>{for(let i=0;i<3;i++){const f=(r)=>{for(const e of r.querySelectorAll('*')){if(e.shadowRoot)f(e.shadowRoot);if((e.tagName=='BUTTON'||e.getAttribute&&e.getAttribute('role')=='button')&&/^\s*Dismiss\s*$/.test(e.textContent))e.click()}};f(document);await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800))}return 'ok'})()
